title: Small cap stock: Exporter of stainless-steel washers entering electronic materials space - Choice says buy; target price
text: Small cap stock: Exporter of stainless-steel washers entering electronic materials space - Choice says buy; target price. Shares of Ratnaveer Precision Engineering ended 7% lower after a rally. Analysts foresee a 27.8% upside, bolstered by a recent rights issue and improving fundamentals. The stock closed at ₹288.5, with a target price of ₹388 for twelve months.
